_comment: Physical limits and MEASURED verb statistics for the v2 planner. Update the verbs block from C:\TETROBOT\logs when new sweeps finish (see docs/TRANSFORM_PLANNER_V2_PROMPT.md section 4).

dock_end_side.note: GPU-measured 19/19 finished OK (gpu_multi_es_ee46.json, gpu_multi_es_ee46_s23.json); planning value (ok+1)/(n+2)

dock_end_end.note: GPU-measured 0/3 finished OK (gpu_multi_ee_ee46.json, gpu_multi_ee_prerot.json); planning value (ok+1)/(n+2)

dock_air.note: target held up by another module: 30-39%

undock_peel.note: peel 12 deg about the rim then lift 20 mm; estimate

pose_move.note: joint move with all locks held; estimate

compliance._source: C:/TETROBOT/sim/physics_params.json + train_v2.xml (the MuJoCo module the GPU runs use)

robustness._note: ESTIMATES (not measured): a light finger touch / bump. Free-standing shapes must need at least minTipPushN at their top to tip over; any shape must take touchN at its top without a servo slipping.
